d: Vibrant crimson hair is styled in a high, spiky ponytail with long bangs framing the face, paired with sharp, almond-shaped crimson eyes and a youthful, teenage facial appearance. The build is slender with an ample chest. The outfit consists of a royal blue military-style jacket with gold buttons and white cuffs, a short green and navy plaid pleated skirt, and white thigh-high stockings with brown loafers. Signature details include a white headband with two pointed protrusions and a long staff topped with a silver crescent moon and a red orb.
